newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George has govt ok for takeover.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George has govt ok for takeover.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Monday it had approval in principle from the Australian government for its A$2.65 billion friendly takeover of Advance Bank Australia Ltd.

The Sydney-based regional bank said the approval from the assistant Treasurer was made ahead of the December 23 meeting where Advance shareholders will be asked to approve the cash and scrip offer which values each Advance share at A$7.30.
Shares in Advance, which is also based in Sydney, ended one cent lower at A$6.74.
